node.title: E1 actual folded certificate payload for N'=128
node.statement: For the E1 open cell N'=128, the named field and primitive root are supplied by e1_pocklington_250bit_exhibit_field and the schema dispatch by e1_named_field_folded_cell_certificate_soundness; it remains only to supply the complete no-vector certificate e1_folded_no_vector_certificate_128_payload excluding every nonzero non-cyclotomic w in {-2,-1,0,1,2}^64.
node.attack_surface: conditional assembly from the proved E1 exhibit field, the cell-certificate soundness rule, and the remaining N'=128 no-vector certificate payload
node.falsifier: a failed field/root check, a nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vector in the named N'=128 field, or an incomplete no-vector certificate
